Callout.Name: Commercial Rubbish Fire
Callout.Message: Fire in the bins behind a business, spreading to a fence.
Callout.Advisory: Staff using extinguishers, fence beginning to catch.

Script.Line: It is the bins round the back. It has been smouldering all night.
It has taken the fence, and the fence goes to the yard.
The yard is full of pallets. Hundreds of them.

Lines.Approach: Staff have extinguishers out but the fence is starting to go. Get there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
